name: cone-6-glaze-drop-hold
description: Cone 6 glaze with a drop and hold against pinholes: 316C/h (570F/h) to 800C, 200C/h to 1083C, 111C/h (200F/h) to 1222C, 25 minutes at 1222C, then drop to 1165C (the elements stay off until the kiln has cooled to it) and hold 30 minutes for the glaze to heal over bubbles before the natural cool. Heat-work model: cone 6.0-6.3 in the middle of a full load, up to 6.9 near the thermocouple wall.
